chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When the deceased dies while in janabah, he is given one ghusl, then washing is done after that.

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا: a single ghusl, indicating one washing is sufficient

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased person who died in a state of janabah be washed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who dies in a state of janabah. It indicates that one ghusl is sufficient for such a deceased person, relating to the jurisprudence of ritual purity and funerary washing.
